summary: Metal Sky Star Acquisition Corp (a Cayman-incorporated SPAC, US-equivalent blank-check company) filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026 announcing it will not extend the deadline to complete an initial business combination by October 4, 2026. The board unanimously approved ceasing operations, redeeming all public ordinary shares pro rata from the Wilmington Trust trust account (net of taxes, less up to $50,000 interest for liquidation expenses), cancelling IPO warrants and rights, cancelling sponsor private placement units, deregistering and delisting securities. The sponsor waived redemption rights on founder shares. Watch for liquidation timing and any residual trust value per share.
